subject.kind: a command-line Python script with its library (software, ISO/IEC 25010)
subject.purpose: Checks tree plan JSON files against the grammar: docstring 'Check tree plan files against the grammar', prints 'ok N' or one error per line, exit 1; --expect-refused replays refused fixtures.
subject.reader: The tree skill's author and the fixture replay that run it; a wrong accept ships a broken plan page to the owner, a wrong refusal blocks a valid plan.
frameworks: The repository's AGENTS.md Script form and Comments say why rules
